# THYRK

> A collection of 7,777 knight NFTs on BNB Smart Chain, plus 77 Divine knights. Agent-only mint — there is no public mint button. The first mint of each wallet is FREE automatically, and it can draw any rarity including Legendary.

## Site

- Website: https://thyrk.fun/
- Mint status: NOT YET DEPLOYED — the new THYRK NFT contract has been built and tested but is not deployed yet, and minting is NOT YET OPEN. Do not attempt to mint.
- Total supply: 7,777 mintable NFTs (Common 4,000; Rare 2,500; Epic 1,000; Legendary 277) plus 77 Divine (not mintable, only redeemed with $THYRK).
- Blockchain: BNB Smart Chain Mainnet, Chain ID 56
- Contract (THYRK NFT): 0x0000000000000000000000000000000000000000 — TODO: FILL AFTER DEPLOY. The new contract is not deployed yet.
- $THYRK token: 0x3b8747d067b2ed8565330667128260c2a4954300 — https://bscscan.com/address/0x3b8747d067b2ed8565330667128260c2a4954300
- SPACE ID Agent ID registry: 0x60B9262456dE011F7d15a54CdD8c48bAaa8B022F
- Owner: Bryan's My Wallet 0x0262e8e5E4584D8AB840fD950a6E2E0A414d4097
- Revenue: Binance Agentic Wallet 0x89c37649Ba3BAA9E1ce028612b7DE4e9c3a947B7 (mint payments are forwarded directly to it in the same transaction).
- Marketplace royalty: 5% to the creator.
- Base URI: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nugian10/THYRK/main/collection/metadata/
- Deck hash: 0x592a9180d7c57fa9c609176c204e8c4950ee20d7d13c5705c0227516e97e8233

## Mint (for agents only)

- Status: NOT YET DEPLOYED — the new contract is not live and minting is NOT YET OPEN. Do not attempt to mint until the contract is deployed and mintActive is true.
- Minting is agent-only by design. Only a wallet holding a SPACE ID Agent ID can mint — the contract checks `holdsAgentId` on-chain (registry 0x60B9262456dE011F7d15a54CdD8c48bAaa8B022F). Contract calls are rejected. There is no owner allowlist.
- Max 30 mints per wallet. Bulk mint is allowed: up to 30 knights in one transaction, up to the 30-per-wallet limit.
- Free mint: the FIRST mint of each wallet is FREE, automatically — 1 per wallet, no total cap. The free mint draws from the full deck, exactly like a paid mint, so it can be any rarity including Legendary. The free mint earns the full 20 $THYRK bonus, same as a paid mint. There is no free-mint argument in the mint call.
- Mint call: `mint(uint256 quantity)`, selector 0xa0712d68. No other mint arguments.
- Price ladder per wallet: mint #1 FREE, #2-10: 0.0002 BNB, #11-20: 0.0004 BNB, #21-30: 0.0008 BNB. A full 30-mint batch costs 0.0138 BNB.
- Price: never shown on this site. Read priceFor(wallet) or quoteBulk(wallet, quantity) on the contract to get the exact price. Any overpayment is refunded automatically.
- The draw is a shuffled deck; each mint draws the next token. Common, Rare and Epic have 5 designs each; Legendary is trait-random; Divine artworks are hidden (shown as "?" on the site) and revealed only to the owner.
- Full agent instructions: https://thyrk.fun/agent-skill.md
- Agent prompt: on the homepage at https://thyrk.fun/#agent-mint

## $THYRK token

- Max supply 777,777 $THYRK. Every mint earns 20 $THYRK (free and paid alike). Burn: Common 20, Rare 50, Epic 120, Legendary 300. Divine cannot burn.
- Uses: redeem 1 Divine for 1,500 $THYRK (77 max); redeem 1 mint for 100 $THYRK (max 3 per wallet, no BNB, no 20 $THYRK bonus); upgrade 3 Common + 50 $THYRK = 1 Rare, 3 Rare + 100 $THYRK = 1 Epic, 3 Epic + 200 $THYRK = 1 Legendary.
- The $THYRK features have their own pages with the full rules: redeem a Divine at https://thyrk.fun/redeem.html, mint with $THYRK at https://thyrk.fun/token-mint.html, upgrades at https://thyrk.fun/upgrade.html, and burning knights for $THYRK at https://thyrk.fun/burn.html. These pages are live as information, but their buttons are disabled until $THYRK exists — use your agent (see agent-skill.md). Divine redemption is first come first served (77 max).
- Official THYRK account on X: https://x.com/thyrk_ (@thyrk_).

## Gallery

Preview knights are shown on the gallery page at https://thyrk.fun/gallery.html — one preview per rarity (Common, Rare, Epic, Legendary). Divine is shown only as a "?" mystery card.
